notes: Holding a song in an album no longer shows a bar crawling across the bottom of the row. The row tints while the three-second hold is running and the Reorder Songs sheet simply opens when the time is up — nothing animates through your song

The hold now only counts while your finger is actually on the screen. Android tells the app that a gesture was taken over (and it also fires that for a finger that is still planted, which is why it used to be tolerated), but a cancelled touch carrying no finger left — or a press you ended early — can no longer pop the sheet open on its own a second or two later

An accidental hold is now one tap to undo: the Reorder Songs sheet has a Cancel button beside Done, the ✕ is bigger and cancels too, and a tap on the backdrop still dismisses it. Cancel puts the album back in exactly the order it had when the sheet opened, so a mistaken hold costs nothing
Done still keeps the new order, and reordering in albums still never touches your playlists
